payload.title: Lab classifier P5: Review to lab feedback
payload.description:
Send editor review of lab decisions to the lab as feedback through the C3 op.
Acceptance: editor review reaches the lab via feedback; revoked membership stops it (C3).

Size: M
Dependencies: Cyclotron C3 (verified-editor feedback op)
Epic: Lab is the single classifier per publication (PPY-922416). Cyclotron-side epic: decision-flywheel-1b8b860d.

Approved by Ryan 2026-10-22; AWS changes need his explicit approval.
